artworks.title: The Return of Odysseus
artworks.description: A Sienese chamber fresco turned gallery panel: suitors crowd the loom with gifts and music while, through the window, the ship is already in the harbour.

artworks.title: Penelope and the Suitors
artworks.description: The queen bends to the loom with her back to the window full of pleading men — fidelity painted as concentration, the thread held taut.

popCulture.title: Odyssey
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Books 23–24 — the immovable bed, the orchard, Athena staying the feud — the recognition that ends the nostos.

popCulture.title: Penelope
popCulture.description: The queen who tests her husband with their secret bed — fidelity as intelligence, not only waiting.
